title: scirpus ardea var. coreanus
intro: Scirpus ardea var. coreanus, commonly known as Corean sedge, is a type of perennial plant that belongs to the family Cyperaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Corean sedge include wound healing, anti-diarrheal, and antiseptic effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
